one_month_reasoning: The window (to 2026-11-05) should contain Q3-2026 results, normally reported in the last week of October (date not yet announced when researched). Guidance is net sales $197-202B and operating income $22.5-26.5B, with Prime Day moved into Q2, so headline growth looks optically weak. The real swing factors are early 2027 capex colour (consensus 2027 capex $277B vs ~$324B implied by the standing AI-capex base case: upside capex surprise risk, as on 2026-02-05 when the $200B guide sent the stock -9% after hours) and whether AWS holds ~37% growth (the July print drove +17% in a week). two of Amazon's last three prints moved the stock ~10% or more, so I widen the distribution beyond the plain 34%/3.5 ~ 9.7% monthly sigma with a fat-tailed mixture (85% at 8.5% sigma, 15% at 20%), centred at ~$255.5 (slight negative skew for the capex-guide risk, offset by momentum since the Q2 beat). No directional call: P(>=256.29) = 0.49.

fair_value.method: Blend of P/E (45%: 23x Oct-27 NTM EPS $12.53 + stakes = $299.6), EV/EBITDA (35%: 9.5x NTM EBITDA $334.8B, less $74B net debt, + stakes = $295.2) and a skeptic DCF (20%: WACC 10.44% with 10-yr at 5.31%, = $144.1) = $267. Multiples sit below peer medians (25.2x P/E, 12.2x EV/EBITDA) because AMZN's earnings convert poorly to free cash through 2027.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: Oct-2027 NTM EPS $12.53 (=0.25 x 2027E $10.37 + 0.75 x 2028E $13.24, consensus less skeptic capex/D&A haircut) x 23.0x = $288.1, plus AI-lab stakes at 50% of carrying value $11.5/sh

inputs_detail.input: AMZN capex in standing AI-capex base case
inputs_detail.derivation: 2026 ~$220B guide (call). Standing view Big-4 base 2026 733 -> 2027 1080 -> 2028 1330 ($B); AMZN scaled proportionally: 220x1080/733=324; 324x1330/1080=399.

inputs_detail.input: Skeptic EPS haircut from excess capex
inputs_detail.derivation: Excess capex vs consensus $47B (2027) and $102B (2028); 60% servers on 5-yr life (10-K), 40% buildings 30-yr (call), half-year convention; half debt-funded at 5.5% (July notes 4.6-6.25%); 50% of extra cost assumed offset by revenue on sold-out capacity (Jassy: demand exceeds capacity in 2026 and 2027); 21% tax; 10.95B diluted shares.
Q2-26 diluted weighted shares 10,903M plus ~0.4% dilution (stock awards 244M outstanding).

Peer median FY2027 P/E 25.15x (range 6.5-77.8x, 12 peers). AMZN trades 24.4x 2027E today. 23x = ~9% discount to median, inside range: AMZN is the only large peer with consensus FCF negative in both 2026 (-$34.0B) and 2027 (-$8.2B), capex ~29% of 2027E sales vs ~12% pre-AI (2024), so reported EPS converts poorly to cash for at least the horizon; partly offset by above-median growth (2028 EPS +31% vs peer median +24.9%).

Recorded value of equity/warrant/convertible investments $229.7B at 6/30/26 plus $21.3B OpenAI commitment funded after quarter-end = $251.0B; 50% haircut for Level 3 marks, lock-ups, deferred tax on gains and AI-lab valuation risk; /10.95B shares.
MarketScreener 2027 EV $2,785.7B minus market cap at reference price; matches finances page net debt $74,022M.

Peer median FY2027 EV/EBITDA 12.2x (range 2.3-53.2x). AMZN today 10.4x 2027E. EBITDA flatters AMZN most: 2027E capex $277B ~= 2027E EBITDA $273B (capex/EBITDA ~100%) vs D&A-light retail peers, so a below-median multiple is used; 9.5x is inside the range and close to the asset-heavy AI peers (ORCL 7.8x, META 10.8x).

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: Value at end-2027: FCF after SBC from 2028E $8.3B ramping to 8.0% of sales by 2032 (10.5% pre-SBC FCF margin less 2.5% SBC); revenue 2028E $1,097B then +12%..+6% to 2035; WACC 10.44%; g 3.5%; EV $1,527B - net debt $74B + stakes $11.5/sh. Sensitivity: WACC 9.0% -> $187, 9.5% -> $170, 10.0% -> $155

inputs_detail.derivation: OCF/sales 18.2% (2024: $115.9B/$638.0B), 19.5% (2025), 20.8% TTM Q2-26; assume ~24.5% with AWS/ads mix, less steady capex ~14% of sales (2024 pre-AI was 12.2% = $77.7B/$638.0B; AI raises capital intensity).
Raw 2-yr weekly log-return beta vs SPY 1.456 (104 weeks); Blume adjustment 0.67x1.456+0.33=1.31.

Cost of equity 5.31%+1.31x4.20%=10.79%; debt $163.6B face (6/30 $133.0B + July $25B + Sept GBP4.25B at 1.327) at 5.6% pre-tax marginal cost (2026 USD/GBP fixed coupons 3.85-6.65%), 21% tax; equity $2,764B (10.783B sh x $256.29).
Below the 5.31% nominal 10-yr yield; nominal GDP-like.

bear.story: AI digestion: the standing view's low case has Big-4 capex at $800B in 2028 vs $1,330B base. If lab demand (Anthropic, OpenAI, both partly funded by Amazon's own $50B+ investments) slips, AWS growth falls back toward 20% while depreciation from the 2026-27 build keeps rising. A Burry-style useful-life stress (3 years instead of 5) would cut 2028E EPS by ~$3. The market then pays ~17-18x on ~$11 EPS, Level 3 AI-lab marks get written down, and $164B+ of new debt plus negative FCF becomes the story. Price ~$195, near the Feb-Mar 2026 lows.

base.story: Capex runs above consensus (~$320B in 2027), but sold-out capacity and the $496B backlog convert. 2028 EPS lands ~$13.2 (a 4% haircut to consensus), FCF stays around break-even into 2027, and the multiple holds slightly below the peer median. Price is about fair value.

bull.story: AWS sustains 35%+ growth with Trainium share gains, retail/ads margins expand, and an Anthropic or OpenAI liquidity event validates the ~$251B of stakes. 2028E EPS ~$14 is paid ~24x, which also matches the $330.59 average analyst target.

comps_summary.peer_range: P/E 6.5x (PDD) to 77.8x (SHOP); EV/EBITDA 2.3x (PDD) to 53.2x (SHOP); median next-year EPS growth +24.9%. Basis: MarketScreener consensus for the fiscal year ending Jun-2027 to May-2028, prices at 2026-10-05 close.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: AMZN now 24.4x 2027E EPS and 10.4x 2027E EBITDA. We use 23x NTM P/E (~9% below median) and 9.5x NTM EV/EBITDA (~22% below median), both inside the range.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: The discount is structural through the horizon, not asserted. Consensus has AMZN FCF negative in 2026 (-$34.0B) and 2027 (-$8.2B), with 2027 capex ($277B) about equal to EBITDA ($273B). TTM FCF was already -$7.6B at Q2-26, and $29.3B of capex was accrued but not yet paid. Amazon has funded itself with ~$97B of bonds in 2026 plus a $17.5B term loan, and Moody's moved the outlook to stable from positive citing the need for external funding. EBITDA multiples flatter the most capex-heavy name the most. Against this, AMZN's 2028 EPS growth (+31%) beats the peer median (+24.9%), which is why the P/E discount is kept small.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$190 (-26%, under the Feb-Mar 2026 lows of $196-199 hit when the $200B capex guide shocked the market) the stock would trade at ~18x skeptic-adjusted 2027E EPS and ~7.8x 2027E EBITDA. That would most likely mean a fundamental break: an AI-lab customer (OpenAI/Anthropic) failing to meet its AWS commitment, a 2027 capex guide well above $300B without matching AWS acceleration, or write-downs of the Level 3 lab stakes. Ordinary volatility would not do it.

key_uncertainties: Whether the AWS backlog ($496B, 6.4-yr weighted life) is economically sound when its two largest AI-lab customers are partly funded by Amazon ($50B OpenAI; $18B Anthropic = $8B notes 2023-25 + $10B preferred in Q2-26, plus a $20B facility).
2027-28 capex path: consensus $277B/$297B vs ~$324B/$399B implied by the standing AI-capex base case; the depreciation and interest drag depends on it.
Economic life of AI servers (5-6 years on the books vs 2-3-year GPU cycles argued by Burry); Amazon already cut a subset to 5 years in 2025.
Discount rate: the 10-yr is at 5.31%; a 1pp move in WACC swings the DCF by ~$30/share.
Antitrust remedies (FTC trial March 2027) are unlikely before the horizon but could weigh on the multiple.
reasoning: Lane: skeptic. I read the 10-Q, the 10-K and six 2026 debt documents first. Amazon has gone from $65.6B of long-term debt (Dec-25) to ~$164B face by Sept-26, through USD, EUR, CHF, CAD and GBP issues with coupons up to 6.65% and maturities to 2076. It also signed a $17.5B delayed-draw term loan. TTM FCF is -$7.6B, $29.3B of capex was accrued but not yet paid, and Moody's cut the outlook to stable (external funding). The bigger red flag is circularity: Amazon put $50B into OpenAI and $10B into Anthropic in H1-26, and both labs made $100B+ AWS commitments. Meanwhile $62.8B of H1 pre-tax income came from Level 3 Anthropic mark-ups - so GAAP 2026 EPS ($12.88 consensus) overstates operating earnings; I value only the 2027-28 operating EPS and add the stakes at a 50% haircut. Fitzgerald calls the OpenAI framework 'circular financing'. Amazon also has a precedent of over-building, with the 2021-22 fulfillment glut (shareholder-suit record). Weighed honestly, though: the accounting critique (Burry) mostly spares Amazon, which shortened server lives to 5 years in 2025. Insider activity is routine RSU sales plus Bezos gifts, with no cluster selling. AWS re-accelerated to 37% with $496B of backlog, which rebuts DA Davidson's Feb 'losing the lead' downgrade. Credit is A1/AA with no covenants. So the skeptic case is about FCF quality and valuation, not solvency or fraud. On 12 peers (one MarketScreener basis, FY ending Jun-27 to May-28), AMZN is near the median P/E and below the median EV/EBITDA. Applying below-median multiples and a capex-file-based EPS haircut gives ~$296-300 for the multiple methods. A DCF at a market-implied 10.4% WACC gives only $144, which shows how much of the price rests on long-run margins and low discount rates. Blended fair value is $267 (+4%). Scenarios are $195/$265/$340 at 25/50/25, for an expected ~$266. The ladder blends that scenario mixture with a lognormal (median $262, sigma 0.34, close to the 34% realized vol), so P(>=$256) = 0.54. It is slightly less bullish than the multiple methods alone and well below the $330.59 street target, which I treat as evidence but not the answer. No option data was used.
